title: VEB Verdrängungen B10 / B
description:
Description succincte

À l’aéroport de Zurich, l’infrastructure centrale est progressivement modernisée. Au cours des 15 dernières années, des secteurs essentiels ont fait l’objet de transformations importantes : le Dock B a été entièrement réaménagé, le Terminal 2 a été entièrement rénové et agrandi, et un nouveau centre de contrôle de sécurité avec accès direct à l’Airside Center a été créé entre les terminaux 1 et 2. Par ailleurs, l’installation de tri des bagages située au nord du Terminal 1 ainsi que l’ensemble du système de tri des bagages ont été renouvelés. La prochaine étape concerne le renouvellement des éléments d’infrastructure fortement vieillissants. Le Dock A, y compris la tour, date de 1985 et est resté pratiquement inchangé sur le plan structurel. En termes de fonctionnalité, de normes environnementales et de qualité constructive, il ne répond plus aux exigences actuelles. Une étude approfondie a conduit à la décision de remplacer le Dock A actuel par une nouvelle construction au nord du bâtiment existant. Le nouveau Dock A projeté, la future tour ainsi que l’aire de trafic entièrement rénovée constituent, avec d’autres adaptations des infrastructures, les principaux projets de construction pour les 15 à 20 prochaines années. La réalisation s’effectuera par étapes, avec pour principe que l’exploitation aérienne puisse se poursuivre sans interruption et que les nouvelles installations répondent aux exigences opérationnelles futures.

Dans le prolongement de ce qui précède, le projet VEB Déplacement B10 / B (PA19AA572 VPK 25-06-007) porte sur la construction et l’extension du salon VIP / EDA, actuellement situé sous l’Airside Center, au niveau de la racine du Dock A. Le nouvel emplacement se situe au sud du Terminal 2, aux niveaux 1 et 2, et offre aux hôtes VIP un accès direct aux processus spéciaux. Un nouvel accès du personnel vers la zone côté piste sera également créé, en remplacement de l’accès du personnel situé à la racine du Dock A.

title: Oppgradering av kantinekjøkken Nordkjosbotn videregående skole (ny utlysning)
description: Bakgrunn Nordkjosbotn videregående skole skal oppgradere eksisterende kantinekjøkken med tilhørende arealer, herunder garderobe, tørrmatlager og pauserom. Behovet omfatter både bygningsmessige arbeider og tekniske installasjoner. Formålet er å etablere funksjonelle, hygieniske og oppdaterte lokaler tilpasset skolens behov, med vekt på trygg, effektiv og driftsmessig forsvarlig bruk. Det skal legges til rette for ombruk der dette er teknisk, funksjonelt og økonomisk forsvarlig, uten at krav til hygiene, sikkerhet, kvalitet eller levetid reduseres. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres innenfor en fast økonomisk ramme. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder totalentreprise for oppgradering av kantinekjøkken ved Nordkjosbotn videregående skole, inkludert tilhørende arbeider i berørte rom og nødvendige tekniske fag. Totalentreprenøren skal ha det samlede ansvaret for prosjektering, koordinering, utførelse, testing, idriftsettelse og dokumentasjon. Kontrakten skal baseres på NS 8407. Arbeidene omfatter i hovedsak oppgradering av kjøkken, garderobe, tørrmatlager og pauserom, samt nødvendige arbeider innen ventilasjon, elektro, automasjon og sanitær-/avløpsinstallasjoner. Leveransen inkluderer blant annet overflater, gulv, belysning, ventilasjon, sluk og avløpsløsninger, samt nødvendige følge- og hjelpearbeider for å oppnå en komplett og driftsklar leveranse. Entreprenøren skal vurdere og tilrettelegge for ombruk av bygningsdeler, materialer og teknisk utstyr der dette kan gjennomføres uten å redusere funksjonalitet, kvalitet, sikkerhet eller oppfyllelse av gjeldende krav. I storkjøkken skal veggflater utføres med hygieniske, tette og vaskbare materialer egnet for næringsmiddelhåndtering og daglig renhold. Bak koke- og vaskeutstyr skal det benyttes rustfrie stålplater der dette er nødvendig av hensyn til hygiene, fuktbelastning og rengjøring. Løsningene skal oppfylle relevante krav i TEK17, næringsmiddelhygieneforskriften og øvrige myndighetskrav. Gulv i aktuelle rom skal leveres som homogent vinylgulvbelegg av typen iQ Granit Grey 0161 eller tilsvarende, med varmsveisede skjøter og gulvoppbrett mot vegg på minimum 100 mm. Overganger skal utføres tette og terskelfrie der dette er nødvendig for renhold, vannhåndtering og tralletrafikk. Avløpsanlegg som mottar spillvann fra storkjøkkenutstyr skal utføres med materialer dokumentert egnet for aktuelle temperatur- og belastningsforhold. Gulvsluk, renner og øvrige avløpskomponenter i disse områdene skal være i rustfritt eller syrefast stål og dimensjoneres for storkjøkkendrift. Løsningene skal prosjekteres og utføres slik at rengjøring, vedlikehold og sikker avrenning ivaretas. Arbeidene skal planlegges og gjennomføres i tett samarbeid med skolen og byggherren, slik at skolens drift påvirkes minst mulig. Entreprenøren skal utarbeide og løpende oppdatere fremdriftsplan, avklare arbeidstider, støyende arbeider og nødvendige avstengninger, samt varsle forhold som kan påvirke skolens virksomhet. Arbeider som medfører stans i kantinedriften eller avstenging av kjøkkenet, skal så langt som mulig gjennomføres innenfor avtalte tidsvinduer. Arbeidene skal være ferdigstilt senest 1. februar 2027. Ved overlevering skal entreprenøren levere komplett digital FDV-dokumentasjon for alle leverte arbeider, produkter og tekniske installasjoner, tilpasset oppdragsgivers FDV-system. Dokumentasjonen skal omfatte nødvendige tegninger, produktdata, samsvarserklæringer, testprotokoller, drifts- og vedlikeholdsinstrukser samt dokumentasjon av eventuelt ombrukt utstyr og materialer. Nærmere krav til omfang, kvalitet og gjennomføring fremgår av konkurransegrunnlaget med vedlegg. Befaring: For at tilbyder skal kunne rett prise dette prosjektet vil det være viktig å delta på befaringen som skal gjennomføres. Se tidsfrister for befaring.

title: Netherlands – Construction work for multi-dwelling buildings and individual houses – Aanbesteding ontwikkeling en realisatie Laborijn-Noord in de Spoorzone Doetinchem
description: Aanbesteding ontwikkeling en realisatie Laborijn-Noord in de Spoorzone Doetinchem. Laborijn-Noord moet uitgroeien tot een levendige en hoogstedelijke stadswijk met maximaal 472 woningen, werkprogramma, voorzieningen en actieve plinten. In dit stedelijke gebied komen de verschillende functies samen, met daarbij een aantrekkelijke openbare ruimte en oog voor sociale veiligheid en hoge ruimtelijke kwaliteit. Dit project vormt een belangrijke stap in de ontwikkeling van de Spoorzone, die een centrale rol speelt in de groeiambities van Doetinchem. Via een aanbestedingsprocedure met selectie en dialoog zoekt de gemeente één ontwikkelpartij of een combinatie van partijen voor de ontwikkeling en realisatie van deze opgave. Naast de hierboven genoemde aandachtspunten is Toekomstbestendige gebiedsontwikkeling (TBGO) is een belangrijk onderdeel van de opgave. In de selectiefase wordt van partijen onder andere referentieproject op het gebied van duurzame en/of Toekomstbestendige gebiedsontwikkeling gevraagd. In de gunningsfase wordt het plan voor toekomstbestendig bouwen beoordeeld, met onder andere aandacht voor beeldkwaliteit, hoogstedelijkheid en sociale cohesie. Voor Laborijn-Noord zijn kaders vastgesteld, waaronder het omgevingsplan en het Gebiedsprogramma en het Beeldkwaliteitsplan Spoorzone. Woningcorporatie Sité Woondiensten is een belangrijke stakeholder binnen de ontwikkeling. Zij heeft de intentie om de sociale huurwoningen af te nemen die binnen het project worden gerealiseerd. Hoewel de realisatie van de openbare ruimte geen onderdeel is van de opgave, vragen we partijen wel een voorzet te doen voor de inrichting van de openbare ruimte. Voor de gemeente is het van belang om vastgoed en openbare ruimte als één integraal geheel te ontwerpen. De gemeente Doetinchem kijkt uit naar uw aanmelding.

title: Madservice - Nordfyns Kommune
description: Nordfyns Kommune ønsker at udbyde madservice inkl. udbringning/levering til hjemmeboende borgere. Udbuddet omfatter ikke levering af mad til borgere, der bor på Kommunens plejecentre. Madservice er en ydelse tildelt efter § 13 i Ældreloven (LBK nr .1651 af 30/12/2024) og/eller Servicelovens §83 (LBK nr 1287 af 28/08/2020). Borgere i eget hjem tildeles ydelsen i henhold til Ældrelovens bestemmelser i § 18 om frit valg samt. Servicelovens § 91. Loven har til formål at sikre, at borgere i eget hjem, der er visiteret til madservice, har frit leverandørvalg. Opgaven omfatter madservice med udbringning, dvs. produktion og levering af mad. Nordfyns Kommune har estimeret det samlede opgaveomfang til at udgøre: • Gennemsnitlig 1.200 portioner pr. uge (hovedretter). Hertil kommer tilkøb af biretter og madpakker. Omfanget er opgjort på baggrund af perioden juni 2025 – maj 2026 (begge inkl). description: De gemeente beschikt over een omvangrijke vastgoedportefeuille, waaronder gebouwen en percelen grond (hierna te noemen onroerend goed), die wordt ingezet ter realisatie van maatschappelijke doelstellingen op onder andere het gebied van cultuur, welzijn, sport en onderwijs: maatschappelijke doelstellingen. De Vastgoedorganisatie Utrecht (hierna: VGU) vervult namens de gemeente de eigenaarsrol ten aanzien van dit onroerend goed. Daarom vindt de gemeente het belangrijk dat het onroerend goed veilig wordt beheerd, waarbij ook rekening wordt gehouden met het minimaliseren van de beheerskosten. Ook vindt de gemeente het belangrijk dat het onroerend goed maatschappelijk wordt benut, tenzij dat niet mogelijk is. €400.000,- over 4 jaar.

Cette première opération porte sur la réalisation et la mise à disposition de 75 logements (5 T2,35 T3,35 T4) en plusieurs programmes destinés à être livrés à l’horizon 2030. La prise à bail par EDF pourra représenter jusqu’à 50 % d’un programme immobilier limitée à 20 logements individuels ou collectifs. Cette part pourra toutefois atteindre 100 % pour des opérations de taille réduite comprise entre 5 et 9 logements. L'objectif présenté constitue une cible minimale. En cas d'opportunités complémentaires, le donneur d'ordre se réserve la possibilité d'augmenter le volume de logements jusqu'à 20 % supplémentaire et se réserve la possibilité de substituer des lots d’une typologie à l’autre.

title: Équipes externes de gestion de projet pour le Service des transports et des infrastructures (vif) du canton de Lucerne
description:
Le Service des transports et des infrastructures (vif) du canton de Lucerne recherche des ressources externes en gestion de projet pour son département de planification routière. L'objectif est d'apporter un soutien au développement et à la gestion de projets de génie civil dans les domaines des infrastructures routières, des ouvrages d'art et des risques naturels, depuis la conception jusqu'à l'autorisation (phases SIA 31 « avant-projet » à 33 « autorisation », incluant parfois la phase 21 « étude préliminaire »).


L'objet de ce marché porte sur des équipes externes de gestion de projet. Une équipe se compose d’un chef de projet senior expérimenté, en tant que responsable de l’équipe, ainsi que de plusieurs chefs de projet. Les équipes prennent en charge, pour le compte du vif, la direction et le pilotage des projets qui leur sont attribués, coordonnent les équipes de conception mandatées et assurent la collaboration avec les autorités, les communes et les autres parties prenantes.


Le portefeuille de projets à traiter comprend des projets d’extension et de réfection de taille et de complexité variables. Il s’agit notamment de projets routiers, y compris le drainage et les réseaux de distribution, de projets visant à mettre en œuvre les exigences de la loi sur l’égalité des personnes handicapées, ainsi que d’ouvrages d’art tels que des passages, des passages supérieurs et inférieurs ou des murs de soutènement.


Les équipes externes sont intégrées à l’organisation de la vif et travaillent en étroite collaboration avec les services spécialisés internes. Elles relèvent directement du responsable du département Planification routière.

title: Z2DA--523A4-CSI-288 3.0T MRI Site Prep - Design Build West Roxbury VA Medical Center (VAMC_ West Roxbury, MA
description: Page 1 of 1 INTRODUCTION: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) anticipates soliciting proposals and subsequently awarding a single Firm-Fixed-Price contract for the design-build (DB) project #523A4-CSI-288 West Roxbury VA Medical Center located in West Roxbury, MA. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The proposed project will be a competitive, firm-fixed-price contract utilizing the design-build approach. The anticipated solicitation will be issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP) in accordance with FAR Parts 36 and 15, considering Technical and Price Factors. This project requires comprehensive design-build services for the the 3T MRI Site Preparation Design Build project at the West Roxbury VA Medical Center (VAMC) located in West Roxbury, MA. This project will provide construction of a temporary mobile Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) suite as well as all utility services and finishes necessary in the designated locations to allow for the installation of an MRI system by the Equipment Contractor. The work shall include, but not limited to, all labor, transportation, materials, apparatus, tools, equipment and permits necessary to provide for the renovation of the rooms, removal of the existing equipment, flooring, ceiling, sinks, casework, doors, shielding and installation of new flooring, ceiling, casework, doors, sinks, lighting, painting, med gas, shielding divider and relocation of electrical and HVAC work. Work to be performed at VAMC West Roxbury in accordance with the Statement of Work, Specifications, Drawings, Federal, State, and Local Codes. Strict noise and infection control measures shall be always followed. Off-hours and weekend work may be required to complete contractual requirements due to the location and sensitivity of the patient population. Existing life safety systems within Building 1 shall not be impaired at any time during the performance of the work. ADMINISTRATIVE: The anticipated solicitation will be issued as an RFP in accordance with FAR Part 36.3 Two Phase Design Build Selection Procedures and FAR Part 15 Contracting by Negotiation. The solicitation will be advertised as an SDVOSB set-aside. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220 with a size standard of $45 million. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued in early November 2026. The period of performance is approximately 430 calendar days from the issuance of the Notice to Proceed. In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $2,000,000.00 and $5,000,000.00. This notice is not a request for competitive offers. All questions must be submitted in writing to the issuing office via email to the CS and CO: Dawn.Schydzik@va.gov and William.Henkel@VA.gov . Telephone calls will not be accepted. -END-

title: Bulgaria – Telescopic sights – „Доставка на оптически прибори, чрез сключване на рамкови споразумения по три самостоятелно обособени позиции“.
description: Предметът на обществената поръчка е „Доставка на оптически прибори, чрез сключване на рамкови споразумения по три самостоятелно обособени позиции“, както следва: Обособена позиция № 1 „Доставка на монокуляр за нощно виждане ”, съгласно ТС О 33.4578.24 – ВО; Обособена позиция № 2 „Доставка на нощен оптически мерник за стрелково оръжие“, съгласно ТС О 33.4579.24 – ВО; Обособена позиция № 3 „Доставка на дневен оптически мерник“, съгласно ТС О 33.4927.25 – ВО. Обществената поръчка не съдържа класифицирана информация по смисъла на § 2, т. 20 от Допълнителните разпоредби на ЗОП. Рамковите споразумения за всяка обособена позиция ще бъдат сключени с едно лице – участникът, класиран на първо място и определен за изпълнител по съответната обособена позиция. В Рамковите споразумения са определени всички условия и на основание чл. 82, ал. 1 от ЗОП, Възложителят ще сключва конкретни договори, като прилага тези условия. - По Обособена позиция № 1 „Доставка на монокуляр за нощно виждане ”, съгласно ТС О 33.4578.24 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено до 2960 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение. - По Обособена позиция № 2 „Доставка на нощен оптически мерник за стрелково оръжие“, съгласно ТС О 33.4579.24 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено до 1228 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение. - По Обособена позиция № 3 „Доставка на дневен оптически мерник“, съгласно ТС О 33.4927.25 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено е до 1439 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение.

description: NSIC�s mission is to strengthen the national security innovation base by addressing the shortfall of private investment from trusted sources in technology startups developing dual-use hardware products and materials - technologies which have both commercial and national security applications. NSIC funding will enable companies to further develop their products, reducing future technical risk and time to market and increasing prospects for private investment. NSIC provides funds to hardware startups which have achieved Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 3 or higher. Under the authority of 10 U.S.C. � 4022 (2022) (previously 10 U.S.C 2371b), NSIC seeks to award Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs) to technology startups at various stages of prototype development. The products which eventually result from awarded agreements will be valuable in commercial markets as well as in defense applications, enhancing the future mission effectiveness of military personnel and the supporting platforms, systems, components, or materials proposed to be acquired or developed by the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD). The current Topics of Interest are found at the NSIC website: https://www.nsic.mil/ This announcement is continuously open; Pitch Decks may be submitted and will be evaluated for the general requirements of the Commercial Acceleration Opportunity (CAO) at any time throughout the year. The availability of funds may limit the ability of the U.S. Government to make awards in specific areas. Pitch Decks are sought under Topic of Interest referenced on the NSIC website. This CAO is intended to ensure that to the maximum extent practicable, competitive procedures are used when entering into agreements to carry out these prototype projects. This announcement satisfies the competition requirements in 10 U.S.C. � 4022 (b)(2).

title: 6515--528-26-4-8085-0154 ICU Bed Replacement
DA10--PACT Act - New Task Order: Cockroach DataBase Licenses and Maintenance (VA-26-00079736)
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs, Office of Information and Technology (OIT), Product Delivery Services (PDS), Data, Artificial Intelligence, and Innovation Services (DAIS) Portfolio has a requirement for brand name Cockroach Database (CRDB) Subscription Licenses and Maintenance, inclusive of software updates, fixes, security alerts, patches, and 24/7 customer support, herein referred to as software support. VA's existing Summit Data Platform (SDP) requires CRDB, a cloud-native database supporting multi-cloud and hybrid deployments across diverse environments. The SDP requires a database solution that ensures high elasticity and consistency to support mission-critical workloads. This solution must adhere to ACID (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) principles, ensuring reliable data transactions across multiple environments. The database must be deployable across various physical nodes and cloud regions, offering flexibility in scaling operations. The solution must also include non-intrusive, near real-time Change Data Capture (CDC) capabilities, enabling seamless data updates to the SDP. The solution must support multi-cloud hybrid deployments, allowing integration across Data Centers, On-Premise, VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC), GovCloud, and Microsoft Azure Government (MAG) environments. Geo-partitioning is required to optimize latency and ensure consistent and responsive performance for VA operations nationwide. The solution must also provide resilience and elastic scaling to handle machines, datacenter, and regional failures, maintaining continuous operation without manual intervention. Together, these capabilities enable VA to accurately capture operational data and deliver near real-time insight and analytics, ensuring decision makers and customer service staff have accurate, current information to better serve Veterans. The Contractor shall provide up to 300 hours of incidental services support within the 12-month licensing period. This support covers technical assistance beyond standard software maintenance, including configuration and troubleshooting. See attached document J&A Cockroach DB Software Licenses and Maintenance

title: Y1DA--CON-NRM 653-27-101 Refresh Halls And Walls B1
description: Presolicitation Notice This is a pre-solicitation notice synopsizing an upcoming competitive solicitation for a planned construction requirement. An invitation for Request for Proposals (RFP) is anticipated to be posted in August 2026. The VA Medical Center located in Roseburg, OR, has a requirement for a Firmed Fixed Price construction project to remodel the floors, walls, doors, ceiling, and restrooms to include but not exclusive of sinks, toilets, piping, and tiling. The magnitude of this project is Between $500,000 and $1,000,000. The NAICS code for this procurement is 236220 and the size standard is $45 million. This solicitation is being completed as a request for proposals (RFP) under commercial procedures and in accordance with the updated Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO). The Department of Veterans Affairs Veterans Health Administration (VHA) VA OALC NCO20 anticipates making one (1) firm-fixed-price construction award based on a best value determination as a result of this solicitation. A payment bond, performance bond, and bid guarantee will be required; the bid guarantee amount shall be at least 20 percent of the bid price but shall not exceed $3 million. This project is 100% set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses. The solicitation will contain the Statement of Work (SOW), specifications, and drawings. A brief description of the work is as follows: The following items are intended to indicate the general scope of work for the project. The contractor shall complete all work included in the contract documents provided in this solicitation. Remove all removable items off the walls and protect all fixed items before painting. Reinstall when finished. Prepare existing walls for a Level 4 finish and paint (14,000 sq ft). Paint door trim in corridors as indicated on drawings. The painted murals on each floor are not to be touched. Demo existing ceiling grid and tiles. Install new 2 x2 grid with gasket seal and new tiles (8,700 sq ft). All items mounted/fastened in the original ceiling grid system are to be reinstalled in their original location. Demo existing 2 x4 ceiling tiles. Keep existing ceiling grid and convert it to 2 x2 ceiling grid system. Install new 2 x2 tiles (3,681 sq ft). All items mounted/fastened in the original ceiling grid system are to be reinstalled in their original location. Asbestos flooring is present and will need to be abated on floor 5. See drawings and specifications for details. Demo carpet and flooring and remove any tripping hazard transitions between rooms and corridors (4,200 sq ft). Install new flooring and make any transitions between rooms and corridors smooth and flat. Demo wall base trim and install new 6 vinyl wall base trim. All work will be performed in the evenings and weekends. Monday through Friday work hours will be from 4:30 pm 7 am. Work on Saturday and Sunday or federal Holidays can be performed without hourly restrictions. ICRA containment Level III will be required. Furniture may need to be temporarily relocated during construction. Offerors wishing to submit a response to the solicitation are responsible for downloading their own copy of the solicitation, and for frequently monitoring SAM.gov Contract Opportunities for any amendments issued. Offerors shall be actively registered in the System for Award Management (SAM), have completed the Representations and Certifications sections prior to submitting an offer, and be eligible to receive a contract award. For an offer to be considered under this solicitation, offerors must submit all required information listed in the solicitation instructions posted to SAM.gov Contracting Opportunities to the designated point of submission in the RFP no later than the date and time set as the deadline for receipt of offerors. Late and incomplete offers may not be considered for award, pursuant to the terms and conditions in the posted RFP. An organized site visit is anticipated to be included in the details of the solicitation. All relevant solicitation documents, including specifications and drawings, may be accessed for download on the date of issue by conducting a search of Solicitation 36C26027R0007 on https://sam.gov/content/opportunities under Contract Opportunities. Any amendments to the solicitation will be posted solely to this website. It is the responsibility of the offeror to verify the number of amendments issued. All offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM): https://sam.gov SDVOSB firms must be certified by the Small Business Administration: https://veterans.certify.sba.gov/ Responses to the solicitation must be concise, contain all mandatory information, and be specifically directed to the specific solicitation requirements. Late submissions are NOT anticipated to be accepted unless the Contracting Officer determines that a valid exception applies pursuant to RFO Part 12. All inquiries for this presolicitation shall be directed in writing to the NCO 20 Point of Contact- Robert.weeks@va.gov and Sandra Snediker at Sandra.snediker@va.gov. No other means of submitting inquiries or points of contact are available for the referenced requirement during solicitation. Thank you for your interest in working with us in support of Veterans.

Der Vertragsschluss erfolgt im Rahmen des Open-House-Originale-Verfahrens der TK: Individuelle Verhandlungen über Vertragsinhalte werden nicht geführt, es gelten einheitliche Konditionen. Die TK sichert einzelnen Vertragspartnern keine Exklusivität zu. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt maximal 24 Monate beginnend mit dem 01.06.2025. Der Vertrag endet spätestens am 31.05.2027, unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses. Bei Patentablauf/Ablauf der Marktexklusivität vor dem o.g. Enddatum endet der Vertrag automatisch mit Ablauf des Monats des Patentablaufs/der Marktexklusivität. Ein Beitritt zu diesem Open-House-Originale-Verfahren ist innerhalb der Vertragslaufzeit jederzeit möglich. Aufgrund des Bestehens von gewerblichen Schutzrechten im Hinblick auf den vertragsgegenständlichen Wirkstoff bzw. die verfahrensgegenständliche Wirkstoffkombination werden die Teilnahme- und Vertragsunterlagen nur solchen pharmazeutischen Unternehmern zur Verfügung gestellt, die Arzneimittel zu dem verfahrensgegenständlichen Wirkstoff bzw. der verfahrensgegenständlichen Wirkstoffkombination anbieten/inverkehrbringen bzw. gegenüber der TK glaubhaft machen, solche Arzneimittel innerhalb der Vertragslaufzeit anbieten/inverkehrbringen zu wollen. Die gemachten Angaben zur Bindefrist sind vorliegend nicht relevant und ausschließlich den zwingenden Vorgaben des Formulars geschuldet. Alle weiteren Informationen sind den Teilnahme- und Vertragsunterlagen zu entnehmen.

description: Die Hamburg Verkehrsanlagen GmbH (nachfolgend Auftraggeber genannt) schreibt die Bauleistung: Grundinstandsetzung der Beleuchtung inklusive Planung und Inbetriebnahme der SPS-Steuerung im Elbtunnel BAB A7 in Hamburg", gemäß Leistungsbeschreibung und Leistungsverzeichnis aus. Die Beleuchtungsschaltanlagen dienen der Steuerung der sicherheits- und betriebsrelevanten Beleuchtungsanlagen in den jeweiligen Abschnitten der Tunnelröhren. Die Anlage ist so auszuführen, dass die geforderte Versorgungssicherheit, Verfügbarkeit und Betriebsfähigkeit der Beleuchtungsanlage während und nach Abschluss der Baumaßnahme gewährleistet ist. Sweden – Forestry services – Prekvalificeringssystem inom kategorin helikoptertoppning av kantträd
description: Vattenfall Eldistribution AB bjuder härmed in er som leverantör till att delta i och prekvalificera för att delta i kommande upphandlingar inom kategorin Helikoptertoppning av Kantträd. Endast leverantörer som är prekvalificerade och återfinns i prekvalificeringssystemet kommer att bjudas in för att delta i framtida upphandlingar. Annonsering av prekvalificeringssystemet kommer att ske löpande i enlighet med de tidsramar som framgår av denna inbjudan. Prekvalificeringssystemets giltighetstid är 12 månader från den 1 december 2024 till och med den 30 november 2025 och förnyas därefter genom att den upphandlande enheten företar en ny annonsering. Samtliga prekvalificerade leverantörer kommer den 1 oktober 2025 att få ett meddelande om huruvida en ny prekvalificering kommer att behöva genomföras för kategorin. Prekvalificeringssystemet kommer att nyttjas i samband med upphandlingar av enskilda kontrakt inom kategorin. Tilldelning av kontrakt i kommande upphandlingar kommer att ske till det mest ekonomiskt fördelaktigaste anbudet där kriterierna pris, eller pris i förhållande till kvalitet kommer ligga till grund för utvärdering av inkomna anbud. I begreppet kvalitet omfattas även hållbarhetskriterier. Ni som leverantör erbjuds att registrera sig i prekvalificeringssystemet för att kunna delta i framtida upphandlingar inom kategorin och registreringen är kostnadsfri. För att vara godkänd i detta prekvalificeringssystem och delta i framtida upphandlingar måste man som leverantör vara registrerad i Achilles (Vattenfall Supplier Bank). Ni finner Achilles på följande adress: Supplier registration - Vattenfall (https://group.vattenfall.com/who-we-are/suppliers/supplier-registration).

title: Cell Phone Services
description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Pristina will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available. The U.S. Embassy in Pristina anticipates issuing a solicitation for Cell Phone Services in support of its operations. The anticipated performance period is for a base year, with two one-year option periods, if exercised by the Government. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered. The solicitation is expected to be issued on November 2nd 2026, as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) under solicitation number 19KV4227Q0001. The Government may award the contract based on the initial offer without discussion. The resultant contract will be a firm fixed price type contract. The Government is planning a pre-quotation conference and the date for this conference will be in the solicitation. All contractors must be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) Database https://www.sam.gov prior to submitting an offer pursuant to FAR provision 52.204-7. Therefore, prospective offerors are encouraged to register prior to the submittal of quotations/proposals. Electronic Submission/Responses: This opportunity allows for electronic responses. Please submit your offer prior to the response date and time. Please ensure your email with your offer does not exceed (5MB), if it does then you might have to send more than one email. or No electronic offers will be accepted. Please mail your offer to the contracting office listed in this notice prior to the response date and time.
